scenes.title: Why is the sky blue?
scenes.narration: Why is the sky blue? It all comes down to sunlight.

elements.text: It all comes down to sunlight

scenes.title: What happens to sunlight
scenes.narration: Sunlight holds every colour. Air molecules scatter short blue waves the most. Our eyes see that scattered blue from every direction.

elements.text: We see blue from every direction

scenes.title: Rayleigh scattering
scenes.narration: This is called Rayleigh scattering: light bouncing off particles much smaller than its wavelength.

elements.text: Light bouncing off particles much smaller than its wavelength
